integrity.mathematical_basis: Self-contained analytic conditioning, derivative monotonicity, exact asymptotics and rational witness; standalone corroborative checker

scientific_limitations: The optimal policy is constrained to one ordered visit per site, no return, and an initially chosen abandonment cap. Arbitrary adaptive revisits and travel times are not considered.
The relative long-horizon order is decided only when the two limiting priority indices differ. A finite crossing is shown to exist in the witness, not to be unique.
Historical novelty is provisional; the complete Hauser–McCarthy 2009 text was unavailable and an earlier search-theory equivalent cannot be excluded.
title: A budget-dependent reversal in two-site invasive-species removal surveys
